epg.programme_title_tc: 香江花月夜 (數碼修復版) #18 [粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老六斥責芷湄，使芷湄回心轉意。婷婷不欲再拖累繼業，向繼業提出離婚，繼業答應。芷湄懷孕期間，老六對她百般關懷，芷湄終亦被其真情所感動，答允下嫁老六。宇深往找芷湄求諒，但芷湄已下決心嫁老六，宇深心中不忿。
一九九一年六、七月間，滔滔洪水淹沒整個華東，造成近百年來罕見災害。TVB慰問團十月再訪重災區安徽省，了解災後重建情況，以及視察災民如何度過嚴寒的冬天。甄妮、陳敏兒、鄧梓峰、梅小惠親到災區探視災民，送上關心；並再訪一眾抗洪英雄，為他們與家人重聚感到欣喜。甄妮亦送上在災區特別製作的<魯冰花>MV。

順叔同行阿丙因撞船意外受傷，順叔、順嫂與大頭李一起去探訪慰問，順叔、阿丙與大頭李更大談行船時驚險事，令順嫂暗自擔心。順嫂不開心順叔不聽其勸告，堅決要行船，牛太獻計著順嫂收起順叔的海員證，順叔發現證件不見了，順嫂直認不諱是她收起的，懋叔亦勸順叔遲些才落船，順叔卻覺得終日無所事事，想落船工作，二人為此吵架。牛太與順嫂到街市買菜，遇上「走鬼」，牛太為拾遺留地上的水果而被木頭車撞倒，受了輕傷。順叔便說不單是只有行船才會發生危險，著順嫂若將證件歸還，他承諾會遲些才落船，多些時間陪她。

達才感到不宜長期處於三角關係中，遂以退為進，處處為亞佳與惠敏製造約會機會，表面甚為大方，使眾人感到驚異。到最後亞佳向惠敏求婚，嚇得惠敏不知所措，但又不欲太傷其自尊心，勸亞佳暫以事業為主，不要將時間放於感情上。君政與家亮為爭一藥廠的策劃權，各出奇謀，適其藥廠東主創基為君政舊同學，二人自小存有些微過節，加上創基當眾侮辱佩汶，二人積怨更深，家亮藉此當眾指責君政對客戶無禮，君政頓感工作缺乏意義，憤然辭職。

學勤見國輝與妙君因階級懸殊，夫婦二人距離顯著增加之實例，令他自卑心作祟，開始對與潔瑩的戀情並不樂觀，終毅然辭去工作，欲從此疏遠潔瑩。其實國輝與妙君一直因知識水平懸殊，不時發生衝突。再加上國輝多年依然故我，自辭去練習生一職後，竟樂於充當小販，與妙君不斷充實求學性格恰相反，二人險告感情破裂。後國輝如夢初醒，決自力更生重振夫綱，並與學勤合資經營小本時裝店，但限於二人經驗尚淺，而且貨源發生問題，引至出現虧損，令二人十分擔心。祖光因不堪珍妮厭煩，欲向她提出分手，欲重新向她展開追求。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老六斥責芷湄，使芷湄回心轉意。婷婷不欲再拖累繼業，向繼業提出離婚，繼業答應。芷湄懷孕期間，老六對她百般關懷，芷湄終亦被其真情所感動，答允下嫁老六。宇深往找芷湄求諒，但芷湄已下決心嫁老六，宇深心中不忿。
一九九一年六、七月間，滔滔洪水淹沒整個華東，造成近百年來罕見災害。TVB慰問團十月再訪重災區安徽省，了解災後重建情況，以及視察災民如何度過嚴寒的冬天。甄妮、陳敏兒、鄧梓峰、梅小惠親到災區探視災民，送上關心；並再訪一眾抗洪英雄，為他們與家人重聚感到欣喜。甄妮亦送上在災區特別製作的<魯冰花>MV。

順叔同行阿丙因撞船意外受傷，順叔、順嫂與大頭李一起去探訪慰問，順叔、阿丙與大頭李更大談行船時驚險事，令順嫂暗自擔心。順嫂不開心順叔不聽其勸告，堅決要行船，牛太獻計著順嫂收起順叔的海員證，順叔發現證件不見了，順嫂直認不諱是她收起的，懋叔亦勸順叔遲些才落船，順叔卻覺得終日無所事事，想落船工作，二人為此吵架。牛太與順嫂到街市買菜，遇上「走鬼」，牛太為拾遺留地上的水果而被木頭車撞倒，受了輕傷。順叔便說不單是只有行船才會發生危險，著順嫂若將證件歸還，他承諾會遲些才落船，多些時間陪她。

達才感到不宜長期處於三角關係中，遂以退為進，處處為亞佳與惠敏製造約會機會，表面甚為大方，使眾人感到驚異。到最後亞佳向惠敏求婚，嚇得惠敏不知所措，但又不欲太傷其自尊心，勸亞佳暫以事業為主，不要將時間放於感情上。君政與家亮為爭一藥廠的策劃權，各出奇謀，適其藥廠東主創基為君政舊同學，二人自小存有些微過節，加上創基當眾侮辱佩汶，二人積怨更深，家亮藉此當眾指責君政對客戶無禮，君政頓感工作缺乏意義，憤然辭職。

白翎的父母被黑幫老大馬彪所殺，白翎為報仇，化身飛天白貓。翎認識了十分仰慕白貓的王秀紅，並得知其父母也是被彪殺害。探長楊克欲將彪和其子馬流繩之以法，故化身成飛天黑貓；克好友蒙龍無意中發現克是黑貓的身份。流舉行盛大生日化妝舞會，誰料警方來至，並搜出毒品，流被帶走，而分別裝扮成白貓和黑貓的紅與龍，則被彪所捉。克為深入彪的虎穴，先將流救出，再暗中釋放紅、龍，惜敗露行藏，幸翎與警方及時相救，翎終親手殺死彪。

文峰搶過贖款，以贖款贏得巨款，頂讓餐廳經營。文峰等到醉紅樓慶祝，長安決要替小梅贖身。方慶及林榮出城探望嵐、峰等，時方嵐等陷入經濟困境，方慶拿出私己接濟三人。黎月嫦出城投靠香五娘，五娘竟用計逼月嫦為娼。

青青主動追求向西，卻未能將他打動，竟著手下假意毆打他，然後上演一幕「英雌救俊男」，怎料其手下不敵向西，將事情敗露。旺財帶沅君上酒樓時，偶遇太大，故意在他面前虐待沅君，並惡言刺激太大。旺財令雅香院生意轉差，然後著艷芳將太大等三人迫遷。大郎為報向西等救小娜之恩，將三人收留家中，形成小娜與向西感情日增。旺財將雅香院窗門拆去後，不肯再派人重新裝上。艷芳感到徬徨無助。太大答應與艷芳分擔費用。太大獲悉沅君抱恙，著想家在賭場向旺財挑戰，並著向西引青青見面，好讓太大能進入徐家探望沅君。

文彪知道創山將有一宗大黑幫生意，派手下加緊監視。文彪藉著冼家德與創山之侄奕炳的舊相好關係，派他找機會接近他，以圖搜集到更多創山的犯罪證據。少芬欲行刺Rocky報仇，事敗，Rocky竟將她毒打，並再次強姦少芬。少芬萌輕生之念。兆祥向漢川請假拯救少芬，漢川不批准兆祥擅自離去。兆祥獲同事們支持，不理阻止，漢川始知自己在屬下面前已欠說服力。漢川受上司訓示，必須打好同組人的關係，竟忍氣吞聲向兆祥妥協。Rocky被控以多項罪名，但仍可保釋外出，創山忍痛協助他潛離香港。

承商被嘉敏無意中撞見他與Lisa共處酒店房間內，一怒之下向他提出分手。王柏因菜檔缺乏人手，迫於使王龍送外賣，怎料他因曾多次受刺激下，患上老人痴呆症，在街上迷路。潔莊獲悉王家因自己離去，致各人生活悲慘，內疚非常，終沉不住氣搬回王家。承商發現Lisa無故失蹤，令他經濟上陷於困境，未能按時出糧予工人，掀起一場罷工風波，終得承商施計安撫眾工人。甄澤欲乘承商山窮水盡之時，逼他退出董事局，怎料王松臨時找得一大客戶合作，令工廠重現生機，而王松受到公司重用，王家從此亦得以改善生活。

賈昭無意中得知淑賢為鼓勵自己重新做人，假意給自己一個希望，賈昭決意發奮圖強。賈昭往見工，老闆終被賈昭誠意感動。賈昭當上保險經紀，更身兼數職，終於捱不住，休克被送入院，淑賢與寶寶往探望，賈昭坦言已知淑賢有心瞞騙自己，但仍絕不介意，望淑賢終有一日能回心轉意，淑賢大為感動。娉婷積極學駕城巴，一日素梅向娉婷借五萬元，鍾晴深恐素梅爆出當年二人的戀情。素梅以為Benny有意與自己結婚，豈料遭Benny拒絕。素梅找娉婷借錢，娉婷勸素梅踏實做人，素梅爆出當年與鍾晴之親密關係。

承商被嘉敏無意中撞見他與Lisa共處酒店房間內，一怒之下向他提出分手。王柏因菜檔缺乏人手，迫於使王龍送外賣，怎料他因曾多次受刺激下，患上老人痴呆症，在街上迷路。潔莊獲悉王家因自己離去，致各人生活悲慘，內疚非常，終沉不住氣搬回王家。承商發現Lisa無故失蹤，令他經濟上陷於困境，未能按時出糧予工人，掀起一場罷工風波，終得承商施計安撫眾工人。甄澤欲乘承商山窮水盡之時，逼他退出董事局，怎料王松臨時找得一大客戶合作，令工廠重現生機，而王松受到公司重用，王家從此亦得以改善生活。

賈昭無意中得知淑賢為鼓勵自己重新做人，假意給自己一個希望，賈昭決意發奮圖強。賈昭往見工，老闆終被賈昭誠意感動。賈昭當上保險經紀，更身兼數職，終於捱不住，休克被送入院，淑賢與寶寶往探望，賈昭坦言已知淑賢有心瞞騙自己，但仍絕不介意，望淑賢終有一日能回心轉意，淑賢大為感動。娉婷積極學駕城巴，一日素梅向娉婷借五萬元，鍾晴深恐素梅爆出當年二人的戀情。素梅以為Benny有意與自己結婚，豈料遭Benny拒絕。素梅找娉婷借錢，娉婷勸素梅踏實做人，素梅爆出當年與鍾晴之親密關係。
方嵐等往拉車，方嵐遇嘉欣，暢談甚歡，文峰則被羅美娥吸引。長安辭職，學做西餅。葉祖蔭與金副官製造被綁架假局，向葉泉勒索。葉泉答允付款，姜文暗調查。長安得悉祖蔭奸計，告知文峰，文峰與嵐、安驅使殭屍奪贖款。
文峰搶過贖款，以贖款贏得巨款，頂讓餐廳經營。文峰等到醉紅樓慶祝，長安決要替小梅贖身。方慶及林榮出城探望嵐、峰等，時方嵐等陷入經濟困境，方慶拿出私己接濟三人。黎月嫦出城投靠香五娘，五娘竟用計逼月嫦為娼。

Nanophysicist Wang Miao and criminal policeman Shi Qiang jointly investigated and jointly unveiled the mystery of the "Three-Body" world of an unknown extraterrestrial civilization. The story of the game with the Trisolarans who are about to invade.

講述地球基礎科學研究遭遇異常擾動，引發科學界惶恐動盪，納米物理學家汪淼與刑警史強聯手調查，共同揭開了地外未知文明“三體”世界的神秘面紗，並隨全人類一道與即將入侵的三體人展開博弈的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story of an abnormal disturbance in basic scientific research on the earth, which caused panic and turmoil in the scientific community. Nanophysicist Wang Miao and criminal policeman Shi Qiang jointly investigated and jointly unveiled the mystery of the "Three-Body" world of an unknown extraterrestrial civilization. The story of the game with the Trisolarans who are about to invade.

講述地球基礎科學研究遭遇異常擾動，引發科學界惶恐動盪，納米物理學家汪淼與刑警史強聯手調查，共同揭開了地外未知文明“三體”世界的神秘面紗，並隨全人類一道與即將入侵的三體人展開博弈的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story of an abnormal disturbance in basic scientific research on the earth, which caused panic and turmoil in the scientific community. Nanophysicist Wang Miao and criminal policeman Shi Qiang jointly investigated and jointly unveiled the mystery of the "Three-Body" world of an unknown extraterrestrial civilization. The story of the game with the Trisolarans who are about to invade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿峰拿著大叔給他的硬幣，再次穿越時空，希望從源頭開始解決問題…阿峰已經失蹤了三個月，盼盼到處尋人。原來阿峰出了車禍昏迷，醒來後卻記不起盼盼和孩子，二人雖然如常一起生活，但卻令盼盼沮喪又痛心。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Phoom, who has been married to Pra-pai for five years, is in a struggling marriage. One day, Phoom has the chance to turn back time and change his partner, and Phoom must navigate his new reality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真的劇作家智恩以為中大獎而出國旅遊，回來卻發現自父母留下的美麗大屋「Full House」被賣掉，為了把房子要回來，在種種陰差陽錯下與新房東--頂級明星英宰協議結婚並共同生活的愛情故事。

時隔八年後重逢, Tawan創辦了一家保安公司, 並被著名歌手Ayla聘為保鑣。兩人重逢後,童年的情愫再次浮現。Ayla在朋友的幫助下努力贏得Tawan的心。然而家庭衝突卻阻礙了他們的愛情。他們能否克服重重障礙, 再次走在一起？
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 8 years apart, Tawan starts a security company, is hired as a bodyguard by Ayla, a famous singer facing stalker and enemy threats. As they reconnect, childhood feelings rekindle, and Ayla, with friends’ help, tries to win Tawan’s heart. Family opposition challenges their love. Can they overcome obstacles and reunite?

時隔八年後重逢, Tawan創辦了一家保安公司, 並被著名歌手Ayla聘為保鑣。兩人重逢後,童年的情愫再次浮現。Ayla在朋友的幫助下努力贏得Tawan的心。然而家庭衝突卻阻礙了他們的愛情。他們能否克服重重障礙, 再次走在一起？

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真的劇作家智恩以為中大獎而出國旅遊，回來卻發現自父母留下的美麗大屋「Full House」被賣掉，為了把房子要回來，在種種陰差陽錯下與新房東--頂級明星英宰協議結婚並共同生活的愛情故事。
小時候的尹俊熙因為貪玩把恩熙跟芯愛的名牌弄亂導致護士陰錯陽差的把兩名嬰兒的名牌搞錯。原本在幸福美滿家庭中長大的俊熙和恩熙兄妹，卻在一次車禍中，因為血液檢查而得知了真相的恩熙，一夕之間變成了灰姑娘...
珍瑪和熙瓊為胸針的事爭吵讓基錫看到了；基錫知道二人是母女後感到被珍瑪利用，而熙瓊則對他哭訴自己已盡力補救，更讓他去勸珍瑪。赫相邀請淑子一家到家裡作客，珍瑪看到熙瓊的生活環境，想起了弟弟，不禁當眾痛哭…
講述了以福島縣出身的作曲家古關裕而為原型的故事。故事發生在1909年的福島，個性柔弱內斂的古山裕一在接觸音樂後，逐漸發掘自己的音樂興趣及才能，並透過自學不斷精進自己，立志要演奏代表新時代的音樂。

LOVE2000的老闆源司突然向由理佳表白，更指如願意和自己交往將會放棄收購A1甚至承擔所有債務。A1的眾人在機緣巧合下接受了電視台的採訪，正當以為店子會名聲大振之際，卻在網絡上遭受到誹謗中傷…

時隔八年後重逢, Tawan創辦了一家保安公司, 並被著名歌手Ayla聘為保鑣。兩人重逢後,童年的情愫再次浮現。Ayla在朋友的幫助下努力贏得Tawan的心。然而家庭衝突卻阻礙了他們的愛情。他們能否克服重重障礙, 再次走在一起？
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 8 years apart, Tawan starts a security company, is hired as a bodyguard by Ayla, a famous singer facing stalker and enemy threats. As they reconnect, childhood feelings rekindle, and Ayla, with friends’ help, tries to win Tawan’s heart. Family opposition challenges their love. Can they overcome obstacles and reunite?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真的劇作家智恩以為中大獎而出國旅遊，回來卻發現自父母留下的美麗大屋「Full House」被賣掉，為了把房子要回來，在種種陰差陽錯下與新房東--頂級明星英宰協議結婚並共同生活的愛情故事。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真的劇作家智恩以為中大獎而出國旅遊，回來卻發現自父母留下的美麗大屋「Full House」被賣掉，為了把房子要回來，在種種陰差陽錯下與新房東--頂級明星英宰協議結婚並共同生活的愛情故事。
時隔八年後重逢, Tawan創辦了一家保安公司, 並被著名歌手Ayla聘為保鑣。兩人重逢後,童年的情愫再次浮現。Ayla在朋友的幫助下努力贏得Tawan的心。然而家庭衝突卻阻礙了他們的愛情。他們能否克服重重障礙, 再次走在一起？
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 8 years apart, Tawan starts a security company, is hired as a bodyguard by Ayla, a famous singer facing stalker and enemy threats. As they reconnect, childhood feelings rekindle, and Ayla, with friends’ help, tries to win Tawan’s heart. Family opposition challenges their love. Can they overcome obstacles and reunite?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 折子戲名為《桂枝寫狀》，主要演員有李香琴、馮淬帆，剪輯自1986年的《歡樂今宵》。
本集節目請來香港羽毛球總會教練和學員到場，為大家示範吊球技術與步法，以及網前推球的正確姿勢及打法。「Badminton識多D」環節，會講解在一場羽毛球比賽中，雙方球員會用什麼方式來決定發球權及站位。另外，主持也訪問了年紀輕輕就已經獲得不少獎項的陳仁傑，他會暢談打羽毛球的點滴。而在「羽毛一族Sure Win」環節中，教練會利用所教的羽毛球技巧來考一考前來挑戰的小朋友。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
大匯演前夕，翁丁尼突然宣佈不用上堂，改為拍攝特備節目，讓五人選出心目中最佳的星光魔法。米露琪突然宣佈放棄C位，因為珍妮花難以戰勝，五人討論如何能創造奇蹟，小祭靈機一觸，作出驚人發言。

兄弟因年齡差距，總是各有各玩？偉豪與十歲男孩開心投籃，卻見其五歲弟弟被忽略，遂引導哥哥分享快樂。嘉賓森美向兩兄弟挑機，讓他們顯現團隊合作精神，但為達成任務，竟設「不公平」球賽規則？芒果乾是二人最愛，森美出招令他們公平分配，寶兒「學到嘢」！終極任務要令哥哥指導弟弟打籃球，惟弟弟訓練時不停走開，細問下方知他想踢波？如何尊重小朋友意願值得大家深思！專家另提到分享不能與犧牲掛鉤，森美憶起爸爸的愛亦甚感觸。

epg.programme_title_tc: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖! #1 [粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「爸知弊幼稚園」以殘酷入學題考驗林盛斌、太太黃乙頤與幼子林道申(Jaye)，被問到爸媽二選一，Jaye口裡說「揀唔到」，身體卻很誠實……一家人透過繪畫讓專家分析心理，「校長」黎諾懿笑言解讀出Bob仍有生育想法？湊仔挑戰正式開始，Bob要單獨教兒子背出「3」乘數表，但零進展下只好試行洗腦教學！看圖搓泥膠遊戲，Jaye完成手作後一臉自信，Bob為錯誤複製作品向兒子道歉，Jaye道出甚麼令眾人爆笑？

兄弟因年齡差距，總是各有各玩？偉豪與十歲男孩開心投籃，卻見其五歲弟弟被忽略，遂引導哥哥分享快樂。嘉賓森美向兩兄弟挑機，讓他們顯現團隊合作精神，但為達成任務，竟設「不公平」球賽規則？芒果乾是二人最愛，森美出招令他們公平分配，寶兒「學到嘢」！終極任務要令哥哥指導弟弟打籃球，惟弟弟訓練時不停走開，細問下方知他想踢波？如何尊重小朋友意願值得大家深思！專家另提到分享不能與犧牲掛鉤，森美憶起爸爸的愛亦甚感觸。

今回「5-Minute Workout」，繼續由Angel姐姐出任教練，教小朋友可怎樣在家中自行訓練。這次針對上肢肌力加強特訓，對大家打籃球或打羽毛球都有幫助。除了增強手臂的肌肉力量之外，其中一個鍛練動作還需要運動背部肌肉，有助挺直腰背，改善「寒背」情況。在「小手指工作室」，文生爸爸會示範「衝天紙杯火箭」的製作方法，成品真的可以一飛衝天！
三年級生負責照顧初次入學的一年級生，小丸子因而認識到久美，更發現一年級生在某些方面做得更好。濱治測驗拿到一百分，被小杉質疑作弊，濱治堅稱是因為自己見到座敷童子，並帶大家去實地找尋。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
光纖之父－高錕，他研究以二氧化矽作為製作光纖的材料，引發光纖通訊的發展，對人們的生活貢獻良多，因而榮獲2009年的諾貝爾物理學獎。光纖全名光導纖維，是一種由玻璃或者塑膠製成的透明纖維，它利用全內反射的原理，可以將光以「之」字形的方式作長隔離的傳遞。其實，光是沿直線傳播，但光穿過不同密度的介質時會產生折射，怎樣驗明光會直線傳播和折射，就要留意MASTER JOE的實驗。
巨人隊改制，實力不足者將被編入後備，為了取回被媽媽沒收的棒球裝備，大雄借用多啦A夢的「賄賂器」。大雄感到自己時常受壓榨，多啦A夢於是借他「感激光環」，讓他說每句話都令人無比感恩。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

巨人隊改制，實力不足者將被編入後備，為了取回被媽媽沒收的棒球裝備，大雄借用多啦A夢的「賄賂器」。大雄感到自己時常受壓榨，多啦A夢於是借他「感激光環」，讓他說每句話都令人無比感恩。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
今回「5-Minute Workout」，繼續由Angel姐姐出任教練，教小朋友可怎樣在家中自行訓練。這次針對上肢肌力加強特訓，對大家打籃球或打羽毛球都有幫助。除了增強手臂的肌肉力量之外，其中一個鍛練動作還需要運動背部肌肉，有助挺直腰背，改善「寒背」情況。在「小手指工作室」，文生爸爸會示範「衝天紙杯火箭」的製作方法，成品真的可以一飛衝天！
三年級生負責照顧初次入學的一年級生，小丸子因而認識到久美，更發現一年級生在某些方面做得更好。濱治測驗拿到一百分，被小杉質疑作弊，濱治堅稱是因為自己見到座敷童子，並帶大家去實地找尋。

巨人隊改制，實力不足者將被編入後備，為了取回被媽媽沒收的棒球裝備，大雄借用多啦A夢的「賄賂器」。大雄感到自己時常受壓榨，多啦A夢於是借他「感激光環」，讓他說每句話都令人無比感恩。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
今回「5-Minute Workout」，繼續由Angel姐姐出任教練，教小朋友可怎樣在家中自行訓練。這次針對上肢肌力加強特訓，對大家打籃球或打羽毛球都有幫助。除了增強手臂的肌肉力量之外，其中一個鍛練動作還需要運動背部肌肉，有助挺直腰背，改善「寒背」情況。在「小手指工作室」，文生爸爸會示範「衝天紙杯火箭」的製作方法，成品真的可以一飛衝天！
三年級生負責照顧初次入學的一年級生，小丸子因而認識到久美，更發現一年級生在某些方面做得更好。濱治測驗拿到一百分，被小杉質疑作弊，濱治堅稱是因為自己見到座敷童子，並帶大家去實地找尋。

早前，有人在啟德河看見長達一米的大魚，專家研究過後認為是福鱷，更指福鱷不應在香港出沒。究竟福鱷源自哪處？又有甚麼別名？本集「大世界 小知識」藉着問答，讓大家了解更多。福鱷除了捕食魚類之外，原來還會襲擊岸邊雀鳥，那麼啟德河出現福鱷，專家估計是甚麼原因呢？有小朋友認為牠是千辛萬苦地游來香港！空氣無處不在，我們平常難以感受到它的「力量」。這次透過小小的STEAM實驗，見證空氣也有抵重及推動物件的能力。
川田先生把巴川的魚帶回家養，花費巨大，因而激怒太太，小丸子建議他寫信道歉和表達內心想法。豬太郎為獨角仙與鍬甲蟲哪個更強而和濱治鬧翻，後來更為了遵守承諾而被迫與富美子玩扮貴婦遊戲。

早前，有人在啟德河看見長達一米的大魚，專家研究過後認為是福鱷，更指福鱷不應在香港出沒。究竟福鱷源自哪處？又有甚麼別名？本集「大世界 小知識」藉着問答，讓大家了解更多。福鱷除了捕食魚類之外，原來還會襲擊岸邊雀鳥，那麼啟德河出現福鱷，專家估計是甚麼原因呢？有小朋友認為牠是千辛萬苦地游來香港！空氣無處不在，我們平常難以感受到它的「力量」。這次透過小小的STEAM實驗，見證空氣也有抵重及推動物件的能力。
川田先生把巴川的魚帶回家養，花費巨大，因而激怒太太，小丸子建議他寫信道歉和表達內心想法。豬太郎為獨角仙與鍬甲蟲哪個更強而和濱治鬧翻，後來更為了遵守承諾而被迫與富美子玩扮貴婦遊戲。

劍球協會的會長與教練到臨，展示讓人眼花撩亂的花式表演，看得在場小朋友滿心歡喜。二人還即席教導劍球的入門技巧，首先要做出「OK」手勢。玲玲姐姐與小朋友們一同愉快跟着學玩，表現如何？有人或認為劍球只需運用手部，嘉賓卻指出要運用全身來幫助接球。兩位嘉賓還攜來多款不同的劍球，其中的幼兒用劍球，設計簡單、輕巧，六歲以下的小朋友亦可安全試玩。另外，文生爸爸會示範製作「紙盒私家車」，留意本集「小手指工作室」。
冬田在回家路上聽到怪聲，懷疑是神秘生物，遭到男生質疑，一班女生團結起來去尋找證據。小丸子做事拖拖拉拉，弄得早起也遲到，有次見山田用時計器計時，做事更快捷，讓她想到用時計器改變壞習慣。

劍球協會的會長與教練到臨，展示讓人眼花撩亂的花式表演，看得在場小朋友滿心歡喜。二人還即席教導劍球的入門技巧，首先要做出「OK」手勢。玲玲姐姐與小朋友們一同愉快跟着學玩，表現如何？有人或認為劍球只需運用手部，嘉賓卻指出要運用全身來幫助接球。兩位嘉賓還攜來多款不同的劍球，其中的幼兒用劍球，設計簡單、輕巧，六歲以下的小朋友亦可安全試玩。另外，文生爸爸會示範製作「紙盒私家車」，留意本集「小手指工作室」。

冬田在回家路上聽到怪聲，懷疑是神秘生物，遭到男生質疑，一班女生團結起來去尋找證據。小丸子做事拖拖拉拉，弄得早起也遲到，有次見山田用時計器計時，做事更快捷，讓她想到用時計器改變壞習慣。

相信大家都做過摩擦膠梳，令膠梳吸起紙碎的小實驗，這就是摩擦產生靜電的緣故。人們亦利用這原理，用不織布做成除塵紙，透過摩擦產生靜電，將灰塵吸起，達到清潔的效果。甚至水亦會被靜電吸引，且看MASTER JOE如何用實驗証明。資料顯示，靜電分為兩種，物件因摩擦後多出了電子，就會帶有負電荷；相反，因為摩擦而少了電子，就會帶有正電荷。相同電荷會互相排斥，MASTER JOE會怎樣利用，做到方便穿上絲襪？

中國人重視新年，從前人們會燃放炮竹過新年，為節日增添喜慶。雖然香港已禁止燃放炮竹，但大家亦可以自製紙炮。因為當大家揮舞紙炮時，內層的紙就會迅速向外彈出，撞擊周圍的空氣，令空氣產生劇烈的振動，形成聲波，人們便聽到「劈劈拍拍」的響聲，就如燃放炮竹般。那麼自製紙炮時，要選用那些紙張才做出聲響大的紙炮？另外，人們喜歡買風車寓意「轉好運」，在設計風車時，扇葉數目和受風角度有甚麼竅門？
大雄等人發現三隻失貓，去找多啦A夢求助，後者用「膨脹地下室」造出廣大空間讓貓兒暫住。胖虎與大雄因不知道閏年而被取笑，多啦A夢遂拿出「紀念日貼紙」，讓他們把2月29日重新定義。

大雄等人發現三隻失貓，去找多啦A夢求助，後者用「膨脹地下室」造出廣大空間讓貓兒暫住。胖虎與大雄因不知道閏年而被取笑，多啦A夢遂拿出「紀念日貼紙」，讓他們把2月29日重新定義。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
除了傳統課堂，小朋友上學時還有機會參與課外活動。有小學竟在校舍內自設迷你高爾夫球場，讓學生透過運動學懂禮儀、公平競爭與自律？這集「My Little Show」請來一名勇氣可嘉的七歲男生，用小提琴去演奏一首樂章，表現充滿自信。有機會的話，他坦言希望與懂得彈結他的哥哥來一場合奏呢！隨後，「表演場地」轉到備餐區，有「小教煮」示範獨特的攪拌技巧，再用蓮藕片夾住餡料，然後由主持煎成美味的「蓮藕餅」。
黃金週將至，小丸子家裡沒計劃出門，於是相約同樣沒出門的濱治和藤木一起在兒童節去士多抽獎。媽媽準備參加高中舊生聚會，為此節約家用，努力做運動和護膚，卻在前一晚發現原擬穿去的裙子被蟲蛀。

這集「Kids’ Notes」，曾於國際雜耍比賽奪冠的劍球高手潘昊臨帶來高難度表演，劍球協會的會長李浩翔亦展示自創花式，他們還示範雙人合作動作。在劍球的世界，許多玩者都嘗試自創招式，兩位嘉賓有甚麼創作心得跟大家分享？昊臨哥哥細談參加雜耍大賽的原因，而在約一千位參賽者中脫穎而出之餘，其他參賽者的表演亦讓他大開眼界。浩翔哥哥還提到劍球界的比賽，在香港亦有舉行？另外，「親子小教煮」會DIY「台式蛋餅」。
母親節過去，德仔因花店忙碌未能替母親慶祝，後來在嫲嫲的提議下與大家一起造草餅送給母親。爸爸突然不喝啤酒和早睡早起，令家人感到擔心，最後爸爸和盤托出，原來他要參馬拉松接力賽。

光大致可以分為「可見光」和「不可見光」兩種。可見光是指彩虹的連續光譜，科學家牛頓把光譜分成7種顏色。不可見光是指紫外綫、X光、微波、無線電波和紅外線。日常生活中，大家常使用的電視遙控器，便是以紅外線發出轉台、調較聲量的訊息，當電視的接收紅外線儀器收到訊息後，電視便會作出反應。雖然紅外線肉眼看不到，不過，透過對紅外線敏感度高的物質，一樣可以觀看到紅外線。而紅外線又會否被某些物質阻擋，還是可穿牆透壁？
多啦A夢突然努力溫習，原來他被發現學分不足，需要接受考試，不合格的話將被送返未來。大雄見堂哥五郎住公寓自由自在，好不羨慕，多啦A夢於是拿出「樹洞公寓」，大雄更邀請大家以低價租住。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

這集「Kids’ Notes」，曾於國際雜耍比賽奪冠的劍球高手潘昊臨帶來高難度表演，劍球協會的會長李浩翔亦展示自創花式，他們還示範雙人合作動作。在劍球的世界，許多玩者都嘗試自創招式，兩位嘉賓有甚麼創作心得跟大家分享？昊臨哥哥細談參加雜耍大賽的原因，而在約一千位參賽者中脫穎而出之餘，其他參賽者的表演亦讓他大開眼界。浩翔哥哥還提到劍球界的比賽，在香港亦有舉行？另外，「親子小教煮」會DIY「台式蛋餅」。

講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

本集節目請來香港乒乓球總會教練鄺君然，以及兩位曾經獲得「最具潛質獎」的學員到節目中為大家講解及示範。第一課的「開心活力趣乒乓」，大家會先學習不同類別的乒乓球拍和握拍方式。然後，會學習伸展操、發球前的姿勢、站位和心理戰術，以及如何接住對手的發球。兵乓球拍為何分為紅色、黑色？「乒乓小百科」為你解答，並會介紹乒乓球的起源。而在「乒乓小子鬥一番」環節，鄺教練會利用所教過的知識來考驗前來挑戰的小朋友。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
大匯演當日，小祭提議打破常規，在正式登台前便在大堂接待觀眾，令觀眾喜出望外。五人一起的星光魔法大收旺場，但阿智彥不以為然。表演完後，一名少女來到後台大放厥詞，她竟然就是阿烏魯。

epg.programme_title_tc: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖! #2 [粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 結識新朋友時間，外向的Bob偕幼子Jaye，與內斂的素人爸爸和女兒芊妤聚餐。Jaye細心發現芊妤衣服藏着一條薯條，打破寂靜局面！他還提到討厭Bob枕頭有臭味而被追問，即顯露出爸爸做主持的才能順利轉移話題。突然難度升級，Bob接獲太太乙頤指示再教兒子背熟「4」乘數表……陪子女溫功課好費神，兩組家庭溫習後比拼搶答測驗；Jaye太看重成敗，專家帶來小貼士！媽媽們驚喜回歸，Bob父子能否展現背乘數表成果？

epg.programme_title_tc: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖! #3 [粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 第二組藝人家庭準備入學，單是一條爸媽二選一題目，「小乖乖」林以晴已令喊包爸爸林子善失守……媽媽董佩欣反映子善對小乖乖稍稍過分保護，但提到允許女兒拍拖、結婚生仔的歲數，子善反而較太太鬆手？家長要於適當時候學懂放手，才可讓子女快速成長！諾懿要子善半小時不能放低小乖乖，並執行各項刺激任務。抱住女兒玩「過山車」、平板支撐、行樓梯、投籃，全程黐到實，子善有何體會？向媽媽示愛時間，父女齊齊表愛意，場面有洋蔥！
本集節目請來香港乒乓球總會教練鄺君然，以及兩位曾經獲得「最具潛質獎」的學員到節目中為大家講解及示範。第一課的「開心活力趣乒乓」，大家會先學習不同類別的乒乓球拍和握拍方式。然後，會學習伸展操、發球前的姿勢、站位和心理戰術，以及如何接住對手的發球。兵乓球拍為何分為紅色、黑色？「乒乓小百科」為你解答，並會介紹乒乓球的起源。而在「乒乓小子鬥一番」環節，鄺教練會利用所教過的知識來考驗前來挑戰的小朋友。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。

epg.programme_title_tc: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖! #3 [粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 第二組藝人家庭準備入學，單是一條爸媽二選一題目，「小乖乖」林以晴已令喊包爸爸林子善失守……媽媽董佩欣反映子善對小乖乖稍稍過分保護，但提到允許女兒拍拖、結婚生仔的歲數，子善反而較太太鬆手？家長要於適當時候學懂放手，才可讓子女快速成長！諾懿要子善半小時不能放低小乖乖，並執行各項刺激任務。抱住女兒玩「過山車」、平板支撐、行樓梯、投籃，全程黐到實，子善有何體會？向媽媽示愛時間，父女齊齊表愛意，場面有洋蔥！
本集節目請來香港乒乓球總會教練鄺君然，以及兩位曾經獲得「最具潛質獎」的學員到節目中為大家講解及示範。第一課的「開心活力趣乒乓」，大家會先學習不同類別的乒乓球拍和握拍方式。然後，會學習伸展操、發球前的姿勢、站位和心理戰術，以及如何接住對手的發球。兵乓球拍為何分為紅色、黑色？「乒乓小百科」為你解答，並會介紹乒乓球的起源。而在「乒乓小子鬥一番」環節，鄺教練會利用所教過的知識來考驗前來挑戰的小朋友。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there is always music to cheer them up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, except her. Soon she will understand the importance of always asking questions to those who know.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello and Goomo dream of becoming real super heroes so they ask Mina to train them.She sets out to do a great jobbut Bello isnt ready to endure the long and hard training. He gives up and choses an easier activity. Something he will later regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello andy Goomo are faced with an almost impossible task when they discover that all the toys in the castle have been placed in a single box. The temptation is great but they have strict orders not to touch the box for they would surely make a huge mess. Will they be able to obey that order and keep the castle spotless?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,are so lazy, that instead of helping, they become a new and increasing problem in Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. This Dodo is the oldest and the grouchiest Bello has ever seen. Soon enough, Bello will realize that this particular Dodo and the special relationship they share, will bring more surprises than he ever imagined.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convincing the children they need to join forces and do whatever is in their power to win!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant run thru the mud or kick the ball with them? Goomo thinks so.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King finds some old stickers which are used to show that someone has a special talent. Bello will do his best to get a big sticker but unfortunately, things wont end up as he imagined. Or maybe they will.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Granpa Dodo is always there when someone needs him. When the kids realizae this, he gets into trouble as they start to need him even for the most trivial things!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Granpa Dodo is always there when someone needs him. When the kids realizae this, he gets into trouble as they start to need him even for the most trivial things!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The kids find it really fun to show their skills in gardening and to take care of a very special plant. Unfortunately, to take good care of somethingyou need to be persevering, a very difficult thing for Bello.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids find it really fun to show their skills in gardening and to take care of a very special plant. Unfortunately, to take good care of somethingyou need to be persevering, a very difficult thing for Bello.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Rita learns a new game, and she is very good at it. The repetition game. She will try the patience of all her friends over and over. Theres only one option to make Rita understand how tiresome she can be, confront her with the best imitator in the galaxy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello and Goomo get into a very challenging project… Designing the perfect toy! A toy that has everything a kid would want, so great that you could never get tired of it. After developing some ideas theyll find out that that object is a lot closer than they have ever imagined.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The kids leave the neighbourhood for their first camping trip without the King and the Queen. Their lack of organization and laziness will turn everything into a mess. Only by working together and being creative will they be able to turn a critical situation into a fun camping experience.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids leave the neighbourhood for their first camping trip without the King and the Queen. Their lack of organization and laziness will turn everything into a mess. Only by working together and being creative will they be able to turn a critical situation into a fun camping experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Being the last one to be picked for a team is always hard. But if youconsider yourself as the best player and its you own best friend who doesnt pick you, then its even harder.This is what happens to Bello, and he is not going to take it very well.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Queen shows the kids one of her favourite toys as a child: A trampoline! They all deduce to take turns to use it, but Rita doesnt want to come down and doesnt let anyone else play, so the others decide to force her to come down. But her endless energy will put her friends to the test.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The group is having a lot of fun in the castle watching an exciting animation series. When the program ends, Goomo decides to stay a little more in front of the TV. And he ends up staying there for days! his friends will have to find a way to bring back the active and fun Goomo they all know.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello and Goomo win a relay race. The problem comes when they discover that there is only one medal. Who should take the trophy? The argument will lead them to announce the end of their friendship. Luckily the rest of the group will make them see that such a special friendship can not end for something so trivial.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 周時新誘騙何日興做生意還債。興女何帶子誤墮騙局被禁錮，新妹周南絲暗中發勒索信訛稱子被綁架索贖金還巨債。興放棄投資生意救女，新唯有偷取贖金；幸子得恩人所救。新還債時發現贖金消失，原來絲已將贖金歸還給興。
（續上集）白雲飛受重傷得師父藍海萍相救，原來飛乃公主，因萍當日醉心武學，致令妻女分散。天龍鏢局勾結清兵，馬君武被蘇飛鳳之父打傷拋下山崖，鳳、飛為救武而與各派爭奪萬年火龜，惜火龜被萍搶去。飛以真元救武。
張國良娶賣身葬母的林秀琼為妾，琼誕子福興。良離家多年，其妻何媚娘與表哥有染，被興窺見，遭兩人合謀毒殺，並嫁禍於琼，還誣蔑琼與其兄林志芬有私情。良誤信媚娘，苦打二人成招。幸何父、相爺重審此案，還琼清白。
胡音、梁福與鄧聲發現一棄嬰，後得知其母是李薇，於是將嬰兒交還。可是音幫忙照顧嬰兒期間，卻惹來女友林青誤會。青憤而下嫁黃佐治，佐治原來正是拋棄薇母女的負心人，音等人使計教訓他。音與青誤會冰釋，終成眷屬。

張家被趙王誅殺，張世傑逃脫偷見愛人雲重鳳，惜被董藩王撞破，鳳為救傑假意答允董的婚事。傑逃至魏國，得公主高俠蘭相助攻趙報仇。傑羞辱鳳，鳳道出原委，傑知錯往殺敵。董叛國以雲母女要脅傑投降，蘭殺董勸父息戰。
鄧秀文在愛人范俊德姐姐范錦平家中當家庭教師，平因丈夫徐錫華溺愛，養成惰性。德欲利用平好友彭瑞霞勸平改變陋習，文卻誤會德變心，華遂安慰文，竟惹平誤會，把文趕走。文被車撞倒墮山受傷殘廢，平感後悔決照顧文。
富家女林秀麗因感寂寞，故當售貨員認識了何月英與其妹月華、李國強、鄭志發。後五人投考藝員，英、麗被取錄，麗更引來趙公子的追求，而與英等人疏遠。麗發現趙公子變心，幸得英等人對她關懷鼓勵，麗感動與眾人和好。
陸義鴻在白芙蓉的甜品店內阻止惡少胡山輕薄蓉，兩人因而相識，情愫漸生。鴻父得悉兩人的戀情，嫌棄蓉的家世，逼鴻與蓉分手。鴻往找蓉時，蓉假裝身亡，試其真情。最後真相大白，鴻父被二人真情感動，有情人得成眷屬。
（續二集）馬君武被白雲飛所救，他感師妹、飛及蘇飛鳳皆對他情深義重，對三女難於取捨。藍小蝶找藍海萍報仇，飛道出其身世，化解他們父女之間的仇恨。天龍鏢局密謀將九大門派消滅，武與各派合力鋤奸，解除武林浩劫。

赴美留學的周長青，在化妝舞會情傾以神秘夫人身份出現的沈潔冰，潔冰因有婚約，拒表露真正身份。潔冰回港探望患病的未婚夫，惜他已過身，潔冰遂留港，在周家任職私家看護。長青舅父馮仁覬覦周家產業，安排情婦安娜假扮神秘夫人迷惑回港的長青，而安娜的情人劉健為騙財又安排另一情婦假扮神秘夫人，幸終被長青識破。長青思念神秘夫人而病倒，周母遂要求潔冰扮神秘夫人，長青卻怒斥潔冰貪錢，後才得悉誤會潔冰，認錯後二人終成眷屬。
張達女兒寶寶常遭繼母碧珍虐打，達撞破珍與術士周錦有染，遭錦丟下古井。寶得亡母顯靈指示救父，於井下拾得夜光杯，意外召出杯仙，與父獲救。杯仙變來酷似寶亡母的寶靈公主作寶繼母，國王懸賞尋女，錦發現公主所在。
陳玲、周大海、李明、亞全以行騙為生，玲對此生涯感厭倦，於是海提出要她誘騙慈善家謝雲，成功後便可收手。玲以美色吸引雲，讓雲對她展開熱烈追求，後雲更向玲求婚。玲為了離隊，遂讓全及明假扮其父母，騙取雲金錢。
何夢霞到鄉下教書，居於崔家，與崔家寡婦白梨影相知並生情。影礙於世俗眼光，不敢與霞在一起，反勸他娶小姑崔筠倩。霞結婚當天，對影苦苦痴纏，被倩看見，影欲辯無從，更因此病危。影死前要霞愛倩，而霞終究難忘影。
鏢師劉義與助手馮鐵牛從惡霸王五手上救了少女李燕玲，牛與玲後來結成夫婦。五心有不甘，牛與義先後遭伏殺，玲被五捉去，與兒子失散。牛子長大成了幪面俠劫富濟貧，常與五作對，一次救人行動中，他與玲終於母子重逢。

江家輝、姚恨水及陳紹強為與胡李達道做生意，無奈答允替道陪其情婦露露。三人送露回家時被太太們發現，輝妻薛冰心遂喬裝傭人往露家查探，果然遇上輝到訪，幸露說明一切，還輝等人清白。其後心、露與道妻一同懲治道。
（續上集）周錦狀告張達窩藏寶靈公主，達女兒寶寶著杯仙救父並令寶靈國王招達為駙馬。錦偷去夜光杯，命杯仙把駙馬府、公主及寶變走，國王限達十日內尋回公主。寶奪回杯，懲治錦和碧珍，卻因洩露杯秘密而與杯仙緣盡。
阿妙被偷銀両而欠飯錢，幸得周添幫忙，並收留在周家打工。添女兒秀嫻與徐季良有婚約，良要與嫻相見才成婚，但嫻因病變成啞巴，妙遂獻計代嫻說話。結婚日，良得悉被騙，大怒。嫻病倒竟因此恢復說話能力，並與良和好。
李霜萍遭退婚後，與表弟張雲生相戀，卻遭張母反對，時萍已懷有生的骨肉，仍無奈嫁予莫仲良，不久良意外身亡。生重遇舊同學莫錦霞，並暫住莫家，得以與萍相見。霞雖暗戀生，但她得悉生與萍的關係後，決助二人續前緣。
「無敵三劍」遭蒙面人殺害，三劍之一杜褒的遺孤杜諾長大後矢志為父報仇，期間結識追尋武林至寶「金匱秘笈」的小冥女及林珮。杜諾被人打傷，幸得邵振文盜得解藥相救。後杜諾找到秘笈，卻遭蒙面人暗算，掉下萬丈懸崖。

書生葉茂青本與尚書千金繆肖梅有婚約，但因家道中落，遭尚書反對婚事，梅為情抱病。紅梅仙因得青相救而動凡心，仙凡兩情相悅，時梅離世，梅仙借屍還魂與青成親，不料青被藤妖捉走，幸梅仙將藤妖殺掉，與青終成眷屬。
徐淑娟為家貧學生林小明與校長爭執，憤而辭職到孤兒院任院長，而明終被趕出校，淪為街童。娟與表哥李義將街童接到孤兒院，明為救院友致雙腳殘廢。娟答應隨義出國留學，義在歡送會上被孤兒們的歌聲感動，決與娟留下。
余潔貞與楊醒非欲結婚，非父要大事鋪張。二人為籌錢，貞往非公司應徵女職員。原來經理王仲庭藉請女職員為名，續弦為實。董事長陳漢松亦垂涎貞美色，貞周旋二人間，不勝煩擾，幸其兄與表妹調解，非父亦答應婚禮從簡。

徐淑娟為家貧學生林小明與校長爭執，憤而辭職到孤兒院任院長，而明終被趕出校，淪為街童。娟與表哥李義將街童接到孤兒院，明為救院友致雙腳殘廢。娟答應隨義出國留學，義在歡送會上被孤兒們的歌聲感動，決與娟留下。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毛延壽借選秀女歛財，王昭君不肯行賄落選。君唱出怨憤，為漢王聽見，於是懲處壽。壽施計向匈奴王進言，匈奴王逼令漢王交出君，兵臨城下，君無奈出塞和番，並施美人計殺死壽。君自盡，屍首飄回故土，與漢王夢中惜別。
細路祥自幼與何大叔生活。一日，祥助飛刀李逃走，獲贈賊贓金鏈，叔遂將金鏈送回給洪百好，好為答謝二人，供祥讀書。惜祥無心向學，與李等壞人為伍。女工呂薇勸李改邪歸正，並送了一筆錢給叔，讓他帶祥回鄉過新生活。
王光瑞與女僕珍兒相戀，珍珠胎暗結，瑞卻被王母逼娶表妹為妻。瑞、珍私奔，惜事敗，珍被逐出王府，幸得瑞之表兄李孔翔收留，並栽培珍成為花旦。翔安排珍與瑞合演一場《祭珍妃》，王母被感動，覺悟前非，終成全兩人。
富家子左志輝與公司職員丁素秋相戀，奈何遭輝父拆散鴛鴦，還逼輝娶潘玉珍為妻。時秋懷有輝之骨肉，不久誕女小薇。多年後，輝偶遇薇，對她印象甚佳，欲收她為誼女，因而與秋重逢。珍守諾抽身離去，讓輝與秋母女團圓。
鐵面道人鑄成紫電劍及神風劍，吳史德為奪劍殺了鐵面，幸其愛徒姚家玉趕至擊退德。德與高戴瑞奪劍失敗，投宿韋漢雄家，二人趁雄上山取劍，殺害雄母。玉與其姊家碧將德、瑞惡行告知雄，三人往報仇，將吳家莊等人剷除。

黃香產子後為生計隱瞞已婚身份工作，經理余蛇垂涎香美色要求家訪，香請老夫子及大蕃薯假扮其父母，豈料蛇對香圖謀不軌，香奮力反抗逃脫。香夫秦先生為幫表妹沈小霞繼承遺產假扮其夫令香誤會，幸霞澄清，二人終和好。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 厭惡狗的瘋狂惡棍利爪綁架了全市的狗!他唯一的條件就是要夜行忍者主動投降!然而,李奧,艾波和忍者龜逐漸發現,利爪的真實身分遠比表面看來更加複雜...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 章魚哥和皮老闆一起登台,羞辱他們的共同對手. // 為了親身體驗海洋,珊迪跟一條魚交換了基因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Squidward and Plankton take to the stage to take down a common adversary. // To experience the ocean firsthand, Sandy swaps genes with a fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深搖滾音樂唱片騎師Amy在擔任最後一次深宵節目主持期間,被一隻蝙蝠咬傷。一場暴風雨將Amy,她的神秘接班人和一位焦慮不安的工作人員困在小鎮的電台裡,在接近深宵時,情況變得更糟…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy gets bitten by a rabid bat during her last graveyard shift as a veteran punk rock disc jockey. When a storm traps Amy, her mysterious replacement and an anxious staff inside their small-town radio station, reality starts to distort as they go deeper into the graveyard shift…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a camping trip deep in the mountains, former Buffalo cop Megan and her friends stumble upon the local sheriff unlawfully executing a drug trafficker. Spotted and marked for death, they find every escape route sealed. To cover up his crime, the sheriff summons an armed militia to hunt them down—triggering a deadly chase with no way out.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..

Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨的阿振在工作中飽受同事的欺凌。當他選擇與由美一起度過生日時,朋友卻驚覺由美竟是一個充氣娃娃。阿振渴望有人陪伴,於是轉向網路,並找到了理想中的女孩米娜。米娜的出現徹底改變了他的生活,然而,當米娜的吸..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely Ah Zhen is bullied by his coworkers. When he spends his birthday with Yumi, his friends shockingly discover that Yumi is an inflatable doll. Seeking companionship, Ah Zhen turns to the internet and finds his ideal girl Mina. Her arrival transforms his life but a series of unexpected events unfold as her identity as a vampire is revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女俠「金燕子」的兄長被山贼擄走,幸得武功高強的「醉俠」范大悲相助,從作惡多端的寺廟主持手上救出兄長。本片曾代表香港出戰第39屆奧斯卡金像獎最佳外語片的首輪評選。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述東遊至中國的馬哥波羅,聽從元世祖忽必烈忠告,到中國各地考察三年,回京後,適逢忽遭反元志士刺殺,幸得蒙古高手護駕,一死一逃;馬憑死者遺言,判斷餘黨必在揚州;馬被任命為總督,率兵將反元者一網打盡;惟馬抵揚後,有感於漢人抗異族的無比決心,遂將蒙兵來攻之事暗告反元志士...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resistin

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, defle

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master’s identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A sweet inn-keeper’s daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger t

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富商之子馮琪偉戀上歌女方碧玉,碧玉身世凄涼,常受流氓頭子林老二及李老三壓榨勒索,幸得琪偉相助並娶之為妻。婚後二人育一子,惜李老三再度敲詐,最終琪偉為愛妻討回公道而與李老三同歸於盡...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her h

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖回到中原時,遇上黃蓉,二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料,同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿,對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰,郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克,奪得美人歸。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘腩沉溺賭海,由於欠債累累無力償還,遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項。事件被其妻識破,並決意離餘而去。餘動輕生念頭,可最終自殺未遂。餘遇上一名富家老伯,老伯答應給餘巨額現金,只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 精通魔法的九幽魔女為獨霸武林,展開連場驚心動魄的武林鬥爭,參與其中的有金獅門少掌門溫劍鋒及集賢莊莊主千金白小鳳。本來金獅門「雷鏡」與集賢 莊「風鏡」合攏起來所發出的靈光,可把魔女制服,但魔女施展奸計,導致兩派不和,再設法去金獅門偷「雷鏡」、往集賢莊取「風鏡」…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A power-hungry Witch who leads the Bloody Ghouls Clan, seeks two magical mirrors, Wind Mirror and Thunder Mirror, which are owned by Bai and the Wen Clan respectively.  She needs both mirrors to find the location of a powerful weapon that will make h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 此片可謂李翰祥導演,經典作《大軍閥》之延續,焦點在幾位當時得令的豔星,餘莎莉、邵音音及楚湘雲。片中「豔趣」特別多…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空科學研究深所獲悉有來自冰河時代的人類所化之怪物將會危及地球上的所有人類。這批怪物兇悍異常,神通廣大,大有霸佔整個世界的野心。為了對付這批怪物,科學研究所所長劉英德以自己數十年來的研究心得把勇敢的科學研究員雷馬製造成萬能超人。中國超人開始了與怪物的戰鬥……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有才華的女藝員蘭蘭與梅梅新加入「馬氏歌舞團」,蘭蘭與團主馬英不和。馬英在報紙匿名徵求女友,蘭蘭與他以匿名用書信往來,互生情愫。相約見面時,兩人膽怯退縮。歌舞團獲邀到日本表演,由馬英帶領,蘭蘭擔任女主角,二人的關係可否趁機會發展?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕貌美的丁芝華為緩解家中困境,與弟弟策劃了一場珠寶騙局,並打算將贓物帶往新加坡變賣。飛行途中,她為躲避海關查緝,急中生智將鑽戒塞進鄰座乘客張志賢身上,卻在出關後失去他的蹤影。無奈之下,芝華只得施展一連串笨拙又滑稽的計謀,試圖奪回戒指。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河東府教頭王陽受地方土紳孟二達陷害,成殺人疑犯,惟匿藏孟家任教頭。後王收好武青年周平為徒,卻惹孟不滿;原來周、孟兩大族為死敵,孟覺聘王當教頭,實乃養虎為患,遂唆使大盜「一條鞭」施以偷襲,幸王逃過大難,只是受了傷。孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所為,且對王很有好感,遂暗中援手...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong’s caught in the Mong’s territory and as punish

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent’s consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she disc

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 延續經典喜劇《72家房客》的成功,本片講述一羣住在香港唐樓的租客被發展商強行迫遷的故事。有些租客願意接受金錢賠償,但有些卻堅決反對。收購計劃最終又會否破壞鄰里間的和諧?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some res

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤膽忠心的楊家將,世世代代為國而戰,子子孫孫為民而死,直戰到最後一員虎將楊宗保,不幸在金山之役中了埋伏,全營將士壯烈犧牲。楊宗保身負箭傷,被困金山,以身殉國。楊家滿門為保衛宋朝江山及替楊宗保報仇,在老祖母佘老太君的發起下,組成了一支楊家軍,誓與番邦周旋到底!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,民初北方軍閥混戰,民不聊生,紛紛向南逃難,三位青年王緒、金正平和魚漢生,夾在難民群中,來到戰區邊沿。王因出手營救一女難民,致遭地方民團首領陳祖光的手下追捕,幸得風塵女子紅菱所救……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公與修道成仙的呂洞賓鬥智鬥法,二人使出渾身解數,不論是笑聲、法力、風流韻事,甚至乎兵器,雙方都不惜一切對決到底!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this period martial arts thriller, three police graduates are assigned to a town rife with crimes and corruption. They vow to uphold justice but are hampered by their corrupt superior, resulting in them putting their lives and the lives of their b

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武當弟子傅玉書殺害掌門後,嫁禍掌門之私生子雲飛揚,並接任掌門及下令要追殺他。雲飛揚誓要為父報仇,於是苦練天蠶功要打敗傅玉書。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍。兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密。珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導演張堅庭在本片體現香港八十年代的大城小景;陳友與妻子惠英紅從大陸來港投靠父親,卻發現他並非如信中所言生活富足。東方之珠的美夢換來悲喜交集。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights

epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King’s sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be

epg.programme_title_en: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇愛慕蘇州名妓三姑娘,為了朝夕幽會,竟然在青樓挖了一條地下通道直達紫禁城。青樓內外,乾隆神出鬼沒,嚇破臣下的膽子。乾隆在民間行俠仗義,更在賭坊大破賭局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor’s sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷,處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟,於是火燒少林寺。事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生還弟子,決意為死去的少林弟子報仇。五人潛心修煉終成正果,被後世稱為“少林五祖”。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to becom

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄龍劇中為一準新郎,但卻遇上心術不正的恬妮單戀癡纏,更借助邪術降頭,務求奪取男方歡心。後恬妮裙下之臣羅烈及狄龍未婚妻,亦相繼加入戰團。一場因為愛而生與死的鬥爭,複雜的關係加上正邪大鬥法,將人性為達一己私慾的惡行,表露無遺。至於邪是否不能勝正?且看結局便有分曉。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barbers apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming’s overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Enco

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiaos Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 泉州才子陳伯卿,邂逅潮州第一美人黃碧琚,心生傾慕;後伯卿得知兩人幼時曾定親,於是隱瞞身份,賣身黃府,作陪讀書僮,以接近碧琚。陝西巡撫之子林大雄,垂涎碧琚美色,強自下聘,欲娶之為妻;碧琚父貪財怕勢,不理家人反對,收下林家聘禮。伯卿得知碧琚已有婚配,刺激過度,一病不起…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Duke’s daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述東遊至中國的馬哥波羅,聽從元世祖忽必烈忠告,到中國各地考察三年,回京後,適逢忽遭反元志士刺殺,幸得蒙古高手護駕,一死一逃;馬憑死者遺言,判斷餘黨必在揚州;馬被任命為總督,率兵將反元者一網打盡;惟馬抵揚後,有感於漢人抗異族的無比決心,遂將蒙兵來攻之事暗告反元志士...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resistin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十萬鏢銀被持神鞭作武器的劫鏢者劫去。因神鞭是有「影子神鞭」之稱的武林大師方承天的招牌武器,所以他的嫌疑最大,也因此引來連番追捕。自此以後,方消聲匿跡。十五年後,年輕女子楊寒雲突然出現,更拿著與當年一樣的神鞭。究竟這位女子是誰?「影子神鞭」的下落又如何?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐僧師徒西行取經,受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山,唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火。然而因紅孩兒一事,牛魔王夫婦拒不相助。孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量。越過火焰山後,師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套。面對詭計多端的妖精,悟空再施神通,護師脫險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan’s fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玉樓發現武館師傅封與妻子有著曖昧情愫後,最後更被傅封所殺。玉樓的弟弟小樓得悉兄長被殺後,誓要為兄報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou’s brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General’s daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述于唐朝年間,沙陀國主有十三義子,皆獲太保銜。姜大衛飾演的十三太保為戰場精英,因而引起兄弟間的嫉妒及挑撥離間,最後更演變成兄弟相殘。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince,  a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家境富裕的大財主立帶男為填房,為了避免那不可靠的侄子奪取家產,他在病重前立下遺囑,更要求帶男將遺囑交給省城的另一侄子。當帶男這個年輕長輩遇上侄子及他的兒子時,更鬧出一連串的笑話。惠英紅更藉此奪第一屆香港電影金像獎影后。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家境富裕的大財主立帶男為填房,為了避免那不可靠的侄子奪取家產,他在病重前立下遺囑,更要求帶男將遺囑交給省城的另一侄子。當帶男這個年輕長輩遇上侄子及他的兒子時,更鬧出一連串的笑話。惠英紅更藉此奪第一屆香港電影金像獎影后。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this “young” auntie, the nephe

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰,在賭館當巡場;一夜,十虎的徒弟及後人等四人,在賭場相聚時,旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲,把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等,昔日曾把父殺死,以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手,殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人,為父報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who ret

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物,不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇壇主,要找出天羅所在,獨霸武林,誤放消息,謂天羅已重現武林,江湖一片風聲鶴唳…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天,並設計先偷飛龍刀,再殺害李志山及女兒小燕,幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫。小燕長大後,更成為武功高強的女劍客,誓要為死去的母親報仇。直至一個偶然的機會,小燕遇到仍然在生的母親,才駭然發現真相,原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Convoy Master Li’s wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li’s Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 此片可謂李翰祥導演,經典作《大軍閥》之延續,焦點在幾位當時得令的豔星,餘莎莉、邵音音及楚湘雲。片中「豔趣」特別多…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 晉靈公寵信奸佞屠岸賈,時邊關告急,相國趙盾啟奏,反被屠岸賈挑撥,下令斬殺趙家三百餘口。幸程嬰抱莊姬之子趙武出走。屠下令殺全國男嬰以斷後患,程不惜以己子代替。趙長大,程以“雪冤圖”告之,殺一家三百口仇人乃屠岸賈,更安排他與母親相認......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江湖异人蕭大師鑄成寶劍「泪痕劍」,不料該劍顯現出凶兆,將會帶來武林浩劫,而他的親生子注定要死在此劍之下。蕭爲了使此劍不危害江湖,將它交給一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。數十年後該弟子把它傳給門徒小高,令其帶劍下山望化解江湖劫數。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial ar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後,應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機,竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源,假扮記者採訪歌舞團,期間君邁與倩如暗生好感,經過一番試探後,二人終一舞定情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李成鷹的父親被多年好友凌豪設計所殺。李成鷹從父親身上學會“十字鎖喉手”的秘技,誓要為死去的父親報仇。於是,他潛入凌家作護衛,期間也巧遇失散多年的兄長,兩兄弟聯手大戰殺父仇人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Cheng Ying’s father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling’s house where he meets his long-lost brother

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權,甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人,之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子,於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察,他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按,幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇,林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺,聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. Wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營,半夜麗芬忽聞異聲,離營探看,突見綠光一閃,隨即著魔。翌日,王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件,期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪,過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得,發現子彈竟能轉向殺人...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May ins

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李翰祥史詩式電影,藝術成就及導演功力震驚中港台三地。本片榮獲金馬優等劇情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美術設計獎項。影后盧燕飾慈禧太后;處女演出即成名的蕭瑤,飾死後受追封為貴妃的珍妃;而為珍妃逝世而不近女色的光緒帝則是狄龍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon la

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕書生寧采臣在傳說鬧鬼的恐怖寺廟裡過夜。雖然他不相信傳聞,卻遇上美麗的女鬼聶小倩。原來聶小倩被困在寺廟中,誘使年輕男子給魔頭姥姥享用。寧采臣得悉聶小倩為一隻善良的女鬼,於是決定助她逃離魔掌。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long’s wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of huma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 威力無敵的兵器鴛鴦刀將要送給滿清的皇帝,卻不慎落入蕭中慧和袁冠南手裏。大內高手卓天雄於是出發追捕二人,誓要取回鴛鴦刀。大戰一觸即發,此刻鴛鴦刀的秘密也同被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the bat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片改編自高陽同名著作,獲第18屆金馬獎最佳服裝設計、最佳美術設計兩項獎。本片講述清朝食鹽私梟徐老虎與白寡婦因清官李振彪拒不受賄,再加上責令嚴緝私鹽,二人面臨緝案危機。為免同僚落網,白獨擔罪責。徐悉白被處死,一心復仇…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力,於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中,他們遇到了一名神秘俠客,三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪,竭力保護黃金不被劫走。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年,光緒帝親政后,開始着手維新變法,惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱,堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁,光緒深知自己的處境危險,於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻,袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密,出賣了光緒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu’s enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Impe

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍,誘殺師弟談鶴鳴;談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭,伺機奪劍報仇。將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師,練成一身武藝,並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀。翼虎順嬌龍之意,深夜到親王府盜劍,然而寡不敵眾,失手被擒;嬌龍率眾營救,與韓九重等人展開連場激戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased masters sword called the Green Frost Sword. Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going un

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 記者仕泰爲發掘歌星小雲雀的秘密,假扮大亨接近小雲雀。後來仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿,小雲雀大怒,請來真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣賞仕泰的應變能力,實時聘請他爲助手,處理歌星登台事宜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,朝廷腐敗積弱,加上金兵南侵,民生困苦。一代名將岳飛赤膽忠肝,率領岳家軍奮勇抗敵,大破金兵,深受百姓愛戴。宋朝丞相秦檜賣國求榮,勾結金國四王子金兀术,設計對付岳飛,以掃除金人入侵中原的最大阻礙。宋高宗為保帝位,縱容秦檜隻手遮天,更聽從其讒言發出十二道金牌急召岳飛回京。岳飛長子岳雲、次子岳雷與
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of Outstanding Drama at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warrio

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子。從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法。最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 周鵬被神捕諸葛森追殺,投靠表兄包妥。林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所殺,要求鵬二人帶其鬼魂上路,到開封找公孫先生消滅杜鬼魂。鵬以大少奶的鬼符在賭場贏取路費,更與戲子吳順超一同上路...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huan Zhus ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitors ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they uni

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile.
